package_info.why_malicious: N/A – This report does not describe a malicious package, but rather discusses the risks and attack surface associated with shadow and zombie APIs, and how Checkmarx API Security addresses these issues. No actual malicious code or package is described.

behavioral_signatures: Undocumented API endpoints accessible in production
API endpoints lacking authentication or proper access controls
Sensitive data exposure via undocumented or legacy APIs
file_indicators: Swagger/OpenAPI/RAML files not matching implemented endpoints
Multiple versions of the same API present in codebase or deployment
API endpoints present in source code but missing from documentation
network_indicators: Unusual or unexpected API traffic to endpoints not listed in official documentation
Access to legacy API endpoints with little or no legitimate traffic
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Correlate API documentation (Swagger, OpenAPI, RAML) with source code and runtime traffic to identify undocumented (shadow) and deprecated (zombie) APIs. Scan source code for API definitions not present in documentation. Monitor for network traffic to endpoints not covered by official API documentation. Use automated tools to inventory all APIs and flag discrepancies between code, documentation, and observed traffic.
